stdx.description: Extensions to the Zig 0.16 and 0.17 standard libraries: fixed-capacity containers, strict parsers, IPv4 types, and the primitives std lacks.

compress.description: Compression codecs in pure Zig: Snappy, DEFLATE, gzip, zlib, Zstandard, and Brotli.

testingx.description: A plain-text test runner, Go-style benchmarks, and compile-time test fixtures for Zig 0.16.

tls.description: Sans-I/O TLS 1.3 in Zig: no sockets, no engine allocations, caller-owned buffers.

cli.description: Command-line flags for Zig, the getopt_long way: -xvf, --out=file, and a while loop.

fastmem.description: Fast memcpy, memmove, and memset for Zig.

toml.description: TOML 1.1.0 in Zig: a strict parser, a value tree, and a writer.

json5.description: JSON5 in Zig: unquoted keys, single quotes, hex numbers, NaN, and comments.

html.description: HTML in Zig, the way the WHATWG HTML standard parses it.

http.description: HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 in Zig: field-value parsers, sans-I/O connection machines, and the engines you build a server or client on.

grpc.description: gRPC in Zig: message framing, status codes, and calls over HTTP/2, with no code generation.

protobuf.description: Protocol Buffers in Zig: the wire format, and a typed layer over plain structs.

bencode.description: Bencode in Zig: an incremental reader, a value tree, and a writer.

utf.description: SIMD Unicode validation and transcoding, plus base64, in Zig with no C.

aho-corasick.description: Aho-Corasick multi-pattern search in Zig, with the automaton built at comptime.

image.description: Image decoders and encoders in Zig with no C: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, TIFF, JPEG XL, and more.

metrics.description: Metrics for Zig: an exposition-format writer and the recording types above it, with no HTTP.

websocket.description: WebSocket frames and the upgrade handshake in Zig, with no IO and no allocator.
